_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
Explicit transcription command waits for its delayed new-conversation draft without following later navigation. The test seeded a conversation {{VIEWED}} at /c/{{VIEWED_SLUG}}. To "select conversation X from the drawer": if the button with aria-label "Open conversations" is visible, click it; then wait for ".conversation-item[data-conversation-id=\"X\"]" to be visible, click it, and wait until it has the class "active". The server's answer to the browser's draft creation (POST /api/conversations/draft) is held back until call "releaseDraft"; call "draftCreated" says ("true" or "false") whether the server has created the draft and, once it has, sets {{DRAFT}} to its conversation ID; call "draftAnswered" says whether the browser has received the answer. Message submissions (POST /api/conversation/<id>/chat) are accepted without being sent on; call "chats" counts them, and call "submissions" lists them as JSON, each with its URL path and message. The message input is [data-testid="message-input"], the voice button [data-testid="voice-button"], the recording panel [data-testid="recording-panel"], and its stop, cancel and retry buttons [data-testid="recording-stop-button"], [data-testid="recording-cancel-button"] and [data-testid="recording-retry-button"]. When a step says an element should contain or have some text, assert that on that element, not with a page-wide wait_text. Perform the steps in order. 
1. Navigate to /new. Fill the message input with two lines, "/transcription /tmp/shelley-uploads/existing-recording.webm" and "Keep this context with it.", separated by a newline.
2. Call "draftCreated" until it returns "true".
3. Click [data-testid="send-button"].
4. Select conversation {{VIEWED}} from the drawer. The URL should end with "/c/{{VIEWED_SLUG}}".
5. Call "releaseDraft". Call "chats" should return "1".
6. Call "submissions" must return exactly [{"path":"/api/conversation/{{DRAFT}}/chat","message":"/transcription /tmp/shelley-uploads/existing-recording.webm\nKeep this context with it."}].
7. The URL should still end with "/c/{{VIEWED_SLUG}}".
8. Eval "localStorage.getItem('shelley-draft:{{DRAFT}}') === null" should become true.

steps.expression: document.querySelector('[aria-label="Open conversations"]') !== null && document.querySelector('[aria-label="Open conversations"]').offsetParent !== null ? 'visible' : 'hidden'
